heading: `linear_scan: false` — expression kinds unreachable in the pump path
text:
### `linear_scan: false` — expression kinds unreachable in the pump path [IRET.9.8]

When the loaded DSC was compiled with `linear_scan: false`, the following
expression kinds are unreachable in the pump path:

| Kind | Why unreachable |
|---|---|
| `DS_RETE_EXPR_JSON_PATH` | No json slots ([LNLS.3.1]) |
| `DS_RETE_EXPR_INTERP` producing novel strings | Blocked by [LNLS.3.2] |

All remaining expression kinds are bounded and operate as specified in
the base [IRET.9] definition.

This is a consequence of the exclusions rather than an independent
obligation, and it is stated because an implementer sizing the
evaluator needs to know which arms cannot be entered.
